headline: FirstRand Trims Executive Bonuses Over UK Motor Finance Commission Scrutiny
summary: South African lender FirstRand has cut director bonuses, totaling 30 million rand in cumulative penalties since 2024, in connection with an ongoing review into historical UK motor finance commissions.
why: FirstRand is Africa's largest banking group by market capitalization; UK auto finance mis-selling probes have raised liability risks across exposed international lenders.

impacts.name: FirstRand
impacts.why: Executive remuneration cuts highlight persistent governance scrutiny and potential redress liabilities in its UK auto book.
